mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when HOUST > 1300K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 151000 & UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals decreased economic output, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) above 520000M signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS > 520000M, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing CPI (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary cycle with inflation concerns, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3% & CPIAUCSL > 260, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2% signals a strong economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3% signals a tightening labor market, but interactions with stagnant employment (PAYEMS) growth signal potential labor market imbalances, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3% & PAYEMS < 150500, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
